input.user_message: My infusion bill lists 9 units of the same drug code. Is nine even allowed?

expert_reasoning: Check 5 (MUE). Bill Detective runs mue_check on the code+units; a unit count over the Medically Unlikely Edit is a provider-side signal. Tier A states the code and units, Tier B cites the CMS MUE, Tier C proposes a corrected-claim / documentation request. No overclaim.
